description: This PHP source file defines the 'Cheque' class in the OpenCart admin extension for payment method configuration. It contains methods to display the configuration page ('index') and to save configuration settings ('save'), managing interaction with language files, configuration, models, and views.

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: Represents the admin controller for the cheque payment extension configuration in OpenCart, providing interfaces to display and save settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the cheque payment method, loading language, setting page data, models for order statuses and geo zones, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the cheque payment method, including permission checks and validation, and returns a JSON response.
